latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the clamp “patch-meta-brief” skill:

- Provides structured patch and meta briefings for user-specified games and versions.
- Separates facts (official change summaries) from opinions and clearly marks speculation or unverified information.
- Outputs step-by-step analysis, actionable checklist, and risk/health disclaimers for players.
- Enforces strong safety: bans guidance on cheats/boosting, disallows made-up stats, and prioritizes official sources.
